    p = list(map(int, input().split()))

    for i in range(n):
        if not visited[i]:
            cycle = []
            x = i
            while not visited[x]:
                visited[x] = True
                cycle.append(x)
                x = p[x] - 1

            if len(cycle) % 2 == 1:
                print(-1)
                return

            for j in range(0, len(cycle), 2):
                q[cycle[j]] = cycle[j + 1] + 1
                q[cycle[j + 1]] = cycle[j] + 1

    print(' '.join(map(str, q)))
